proposed_comments.title: Add regression coverage for Win+L chords
proposed_comments.body:
### Add regression coverage for Win+L chords

**Severity:** `medium`

The condition now changes behavior for shortcuts with extra modifiers, but the diff does not test those combinations while the modifiers remain enabled. Please add direct coverage for at least Win+Ctrl+L and Win+Shift+L, asserting `ShortcutErrorType::WinL`, so this regression cannot silently return.
